design_principles: One observed-data task per recipe by default; task designs can share inputs only when a coherent study supports the endpoints. These refine the broad portfolio rather than add directly to its question count.
All designs are prospective. Artifact lists give proposed key columns, not complete schemas. Freeze complete output types, undefined-value policies, tolerances and package versions before execution.

Input data must have independent biological provenance, source accessions, licenses, checksums and biological dimensions. Exclude benchmark fixtures, answers and source-study lineages; a new URL for the same study is not independent data.
Use native biological formats, actual package reference execution and independent arithmetic/input invariants. A matching scalar does not establish a connected workflow.
Negative controls mutate observable submitted artifacts against fixed real inputs. The grader checks recorded splits and provenance but cannot prove hidden model-training or selection history.

Observe the 30-minute offline limit with measured native executions. Large genomic models and full pipelines require runtime/resource review; no unplanned GPU or cloud spend is authorized by this design file.

Explicitly simulated source tasks require observed-data alternatives and independent measured truth. Controlled artifact mutations are verifier tests, not biological training observations. Label designed sequence variants modified-real.
The two parameter-count endpoints and subjective shape endpoint remain supporting or non-equivalent components; they do not count as full observed biological workflows.

Independent invariants supplement comparison of every required artifact with the private input-reading native reference; nonnegativity, sums and reconstruction error alone do not establish correct inferred labels or proportions. Pin seeds/tolerances and define acceptable nonunique outputs or abstention before execution.

native_format_acceptance_contract.source_endpoint: Infer library pairing/read length and count properly paired reads at a quality threshold of 30. The source does not specify primary/duplicate eligibility, >= versus >, or heterogeneous length handling.
authored_task_decisions: For the authored count, require mapped primary records with paired and proper-pair flags, exclude secondary, supplementary, QC-fail and duplicate flags, and require 30 <= MAPQ < 255. Count alignment records, including both eligible mates; do not divide by two.

Describe pairing and length on all primary non-QC-fail records, retaining a separate missing-SEQ count. Report paired/unpaired proportions and the complete stored-SEQ length histogram; a single library label is allowed only if homogeneous. Do not silently call a mixed library single-ended.

Stored query length includes soft clipping and insertions, excludes hard clipping, deletions and skipped reference regions. Aligned-query length sums CIGAR M,I,=,X operations. A hard-clipped BAM cannot establish the original sequencer read length without original FASTQ.
Keep each record identifiable by ordinal plus read group, QNAME and mate flag; QNAME alone is not unique. MAPQ 255 is unavailable quality, even though a plain numeric threshold would retain it.

native_format_acceptance_contract.source_endpoint: Return strand-aware promoter coordinates and GC fraction; the interval query additionally requires uppercase sequence MD5, length and N count.
authored_task_decisions: Task-facing coordinates are 1-based closed; extraction converts [s,e] to [s-1,e). Fix the full transcript version and assembly, use start as plus-strand TSS and end as minus-strand TSS.

For upstream U and downstream D, use [TSS-U,TSS+D-1] on plus and [TSS-D+1,TSS+U] on minus. This authoring convention gives U+D bases with D including the TSS. Reject out-of-contig windows during input selection rather than silently clipping.

Use uppercase FASTA sequence. GC fraction is (G+C)/all window bases, including ambiguous bases in the denominator; report N separately and retain other IUPAC ambiguity counts. Reverse-complement the minus-strand sequence with a complete IUPAC mapping.

Hash ASCII sequence letters only, with no FASTA header, spaces or newline. Return forward and oriented hashes separately. Use decimal round-half-even at the requested precision, explicitly stated in the authored prompt.
